name: Boom Hour adds critical chance to Bomb Toss and Firepot (#1232)
contract: #1232: Boom Hour 802963 is a native ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107) passive, EffectMiscValue 7 SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE, BasePoints 9 DieSides 1 (+10), EffectSpellClassMask (0,0,128). Unit::SpellDoneCritChance consumes SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE through Player::ApplySpellMod. The CoA route for this modifier is already in the core: SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod has `case 802963: return root == 801005 || Id == 500601;` in its SpellFamilyName 34 branch, which keeps the modifier on the whole Bomb Toss rank chain and adds Firepot 500601, whose SpellFamilyFlags (0,0,0) the raw mask could never reach. spell_ranks declares the chain root of 502510 (rank 2) and 547209 (rank 8) as 801005. The only other family-34 row carrying mask bit (0,0,128) is the unreferenced duplicate Bomb Toss 561107, which is not in that chain and which the route therefore excludes; asserting zero on it is the regression guard for the route itself.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Bomb Toss has no extra critical chance without Boom Hour
Boom Hour adds 10 points of critical chance to Bomb Toss
Boom Hour reaches Bomb Toss rank 2
Boom Hour reaches Bomb Toss rank 8
Firepot has no extra critical chance without Boom Hour
Boom Hour adds 10 points of critical chance to Firepot
The route excludes the unreferenced Bomb Toss row that shares the mask bit
